div.head: Af 3
div.ab: IIII. Gif hwa cyninges borh abrece, gebete þone tihtlan swa him riht wisie, ⁊ þæs borges bryce mid V pundum mærra peninga. Ercebiscopes borges bryce oððe his mundbyrd gebete mid III pundum. Oðres biscopes oððe ealdermannes borges brice oððe his mundbyrd gebete mid twam pundum.

IIII. Gif hwa cyninges borg abrece, gebete þone tyht swa him ryht wisie, ⁊ þæs borges bryce mid V pundum mærra pæninga. Ærcebiscepes borges bryce oððe his mundbyrd gebete mid ðrim pundum. Oðres biscepes oððe ealdormonnes borges bryce oððe mundbyrd gebete mid twam pundum.
…… Oþres bisceopes oððe ealdormannes borges bryce oððe mundbyrd gebete mid II pundum.

Si quis plegium regis infringat, emendet inculpationem sicut rectum sit, et infracturam plegii quinque libris merorum denariorum. Archiepiscopi borhbrece siue mundbird emendetur tribus libris, aliorum episcoporum uel aldermannorum (comitum) emendetur II libris.

{IIII} Gif hwa cyninges borg abrece, gebete þone tyht swa him ryht wisie, ⁊ þæs borges bryce mid V pundum mærra pæninga. Ærcebiscepes borges bryce oððe his mundbyrd gebete mid ðrim pundum. Oðres biscepes oððe ealdormonnes borges bryce oððe mundbyrd gebete mid twam pundum.

If someone breaches the king’s security, let him compensate for that offense as law indicates, and for the breach of that security with 5 pounds of greater pennies. Let him compensate breaching an archbishop’s security or violation of his mund with three pounds. Let him compensate breaching the security of a bishop [of other rank] or an ealdorman, or the violation of [their] mund with two pounds.

If anyone violates the king's protection, he shall pay compensation for the crime [to the injured person], as the law directs him, and 5 pounds of pure silver pennies for violation of the king's protection; for the violation of the archbishop's protection or guardianship 3 pounds must be paid as compensation; for violation of the protection or guardianship of any other bishop or of an ealdorman 2 pounds must be paid as compensation.

Wenn jemand die vom König [gewährte] Bürgschaft verletzt, so büsse er die Inzicht [dem Kläger], wie ihm das Gericht zuerkennt, und die Verletzung jenes Bürgschaftsschutzes mit 5 Pfund Pfennigen reinen [Silbers dem Könige]. Die Verletzung einer vom Erzbischof [gewährten] Bürgschaft oder dessen Schutzgewalt büsse man [diesem] mit 3 Pfund. Die Verletzung einer von einem anderen Bischofe oder einem Ealdorman [gewährten] Bürgschaft oder [dessen] Schutzgewalt büsse man [ihm] mit 2 Pfund.

If someone violates the surety [granted] by the king, let him compensate for the charge [to the plaintiff] as the court awards him, and for the violation of that surety-protection with 5 pounds of pennies of pure [silver, to the king]. The violation of a surety [granted] by the archbishop, or of his protective authority, is to be compensated [to him] with 3 pounds. The violation of a surety [granted] by another bishop or by an ealdorman, or of [his] protective authority, is to be compensated [to him] with 2 pounds.
